$comment: THE FOUR SEASONS - location prompt spec. Same slot discipline as character_prompt_spec.json. Locations carry no people; a scene prompt is a location prompt plus a character prompt.

slot_definitions.space: What kind of room or place, its scale and enclosure. Enclosure is the horror lever - say whether it can be left.
slot_definitions.surfaces: Floor, walls, and the material the body will touch. This is what stains, soaks, or reflects.
slot_definitions.light: Source, direction, colour temperature, time of day.
slot_definitions.weather_air: Temperature, humidity, smell, sound. Drives the physical sensation in prose even when invisible in an image.
slot_definitions.props: Objects that carry meaning. Keep to three or fewer - a prop list longer than that stops reading as composition.
slot_definitions.camera: Height, distance, lens feel. Fixed per location so repeat generations match.
slot_definitions.tone: Seasonal palette and contrast, matching the chapter.

conventions.no_people: Location prompts must not contain a person. Compose with a character prompt at generation time.

negative_prompt: people, person, human, figure, worst quality, low quality, text, watermark, signature, jpeg artifacts, blurry

meeting-room.ja: 政治家たちの密室・会議室

slots.space: windowless interior meeting room, heavy closed double doors, oppressively low ceiling, no visible exit
slots.surfaces: long polished dark wood table, deep carpet swallowing sound, leather chairs
slots.light: recessed downlights only, cold and even, no daylight, hard shadows under the table
slots.weather_air: stale overwarm air, no circulation, faint smell of tobacco and paper
slots.props: water glasses left untouched, a closed document folder, a wall clock
slots.camera: eye level, medium wide, slight wide-angle compression toward the doors
slots.tone: spring chapter palette, low contrast, desaturated

slots.space: open rooftop swimming pool of a school, chain-link fence enclosing the whole roof, city rooftops beyond, no shade
slots.surfaces: wet pale blue tiled poolside, still chlorinated water, hot concrete, galvanised chain-link and a padlock
slots.light: brutal high midday summer sun straight overhead, glare off the water, short hard shadows
slots.weather_air: blazing heat, chlorine and sunscreen, cicadas, absolute stillness of a closed summer school
slots.props: a padlock clipped through the fence, a discarded swimsuit strap, a folded towel
slots.camera: eye level, wide, strong sun flare
slots.tone: summer chapter palette, bleached highlights, deep blue shadow

summer-classroom.ja: 補習授業中の教室・カーテン裏

slots.space: occupied high school classroom during summer supplementary lessons, desks filled, tall window wall along one side, heavy curtains half drawn
slots.surfaces: large window glass, worn curtain fabric, scuffed wooden floor, chalk dust
slots.light: hard summer daylight pouring through the window wall, the curtain glowing translucent from behind, silhouettes readable through the fabric
slots.weather_air: hot humid air, ceiling fan, the drone of a lesson, schoolyard noise from outside
slots.props: a half-drawn curtain, the window glass, rows of occupied desks
slots.camera: from outside the window looking in, eye level, medium - the schoolyard vantage point
slots.tone: summer chapter palette, low contrast, harsh backlight

campsite-mud.ja: 社内キャンプ場・紅葉の泥

slots.space: outdoor company retreat campsite clearing in deep autumn woods, toilet block visible but too far
slots.surfaces: churned brown mud, wet fallen leaves, exposed tree roots
slots.light: low overcast afternoon light, no direct sun, flat and grey
slots.weather_air: cold damp air, smell of wet earth and rot, distant water
slots.props: a single dark brown pump half sunk in mud, scattered maple leaves, a washstand in the background
slots.camera: low angle near ground level, close, shallow depth of field
slots.tone: autumn chapter palette, medium contrast, mud tones close to the character palette

private-room.ja: 静まり返った自室・炬燵

slots.space: small cold single-room apartment, curtains drawn, door shut, nowhere to be seen and nobody coming
slots.surfaces: tatami or thin carpet, a kotatsu with a heavy quilt, cold bare floor beyond its edge
slots.light: weak grey winter daylight through drawn curtains, the kotatsu glowing faintly orange underneath
slots.weather_air: freezing still air outside the quilt, silence, faint hum of the heater
slots.props: discarded tights and skirt beside the kotatsu, an unwatched screen, a mug gone cold
slots.tone: winter chapter palette, highest contrast, cold blue against the orange pocket of warmth

school-corridor.ja: 学校・トイレ前の廊下

slots.space: school corridor outside the toilets, long straight sightline, students able to appear from either end
slots.surfaces: polished linoleum reflecting the windows, painted concrete walls, a row of lockers
slots.light: flat spring daylight from a window wall, even and unforgiving, nothing to hide in
slots.weather_air: mild air, distant noise of a class, footsteps
slots.props: a toilet door standing ajar, a notice board, a wooden hanger
slots.camera: eye level, long lens down the corridor, deep focus
slots.tone: spring chapter palette returning, low contrast, brighter than chapter 1
